title: install-local: the cached-manifest directory is resolved from the working directory, not OS_HOME, so `os dev --fresh` rehydrates a previous install
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location and a measured reach. Found by the #30106 dev (os-dev report 6647662239 on #30106, `out_of_scope_findings` item 2) and first seen by the #30106 filer (comment 6633535319, "Where the cached file lives"). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Business reason: a developer runs `os dev --fresh` (or a second instance with a different `OS_HOME` and a fresh database) to start clean, and a package installed by an earlier run comes back. Tests contaminate each other, and in a container whose working directory is not on a volume an install may not survive a container replacement (not measured).

Reader who acts: `domain:server`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/local-manifest-source.ts` (default directory) and the CLI `serve` wiring that constructs the plugin without a storage directory.

Dedupe (open and closed): `installed-packages OS_HOME` (26 hits, none on this; nearest #30106), `LocalManifestSource cwd` (4 hits: #30106, #5412, #5612, #5996, the closed three about `os doctor`'s ledger read), `fresh install-local cache` (88 hits, none on this). **New.**

## What happens (measured by the #30106 dev)

- `os dev --fresh`, then a managed `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, writes `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages/ID.json` (measured under `examples/app-showcase` with a fresh `OS_HOME`).
- The next `--fresh` boot rehydrates that entry (measured).

## Reading

`local-manifest-source.ts` defaults to `resolve(process.cwd(), DEFAULT_INSTALLED_PACKAGES_DIR)`; `serve.ts` constructs the plugin without `storageDir`; `dev.ts` states that state not keyed off `OS_HOME` is not covered by `--fresh`. Moving the directory needs a read of the old location for existing installs. PR #30207 stops a `.custom` pair from writing this file at all; other packages still do.

## Expected

The cached-manifest directory follows `OS_HOME` (or the instance's data directory), and `--fresh` starts without earlier installs.
